mintAuthority.summary: USDR is a single-chain Ethereum MiCA EMT; token owner is a 2/2 legacy multisig (no modules), proxy admin is a separate 2/2 multisig (no modules), both confirmed at current block. Prior record had proxy admin as 1/1 — corrected.

mintIncidents.summary: A compromised StablR mint/governance key let the attacker mint 8.35M unbacked USDR as part of a coordinated USDR/EURR attack, leaving both tokens undercollateralized and forcing mint/redeem suspension.

review.evidence: At block 25294990: token owner = 0xC7Dcd...0E4 (2/2 multisig, no modules confirmed). Proxy admin = 0xbfFF...953c (2/2 multisig, no modules confirmed; prior 1/1 record was incorrect — corrected from live reads). Implementation = 0x76e0baef381656d51d733cf9aa60d7bf8017f958. USDR is a single-chain MiCAR EMT; the May 2026 exploit compromised the mint key; post-incident multisig state confirmed above. Economic-posture fields reviewed 2026-08-15: issuer multisigs can authorize or replace mint logic without an independent timelock, Grant Thornton reconciles reserves quarterly, and MFSA authorizes StablR Ltd as a MiCA EMT issuer.
